name: QAI Lab Pipeline and Notebook Reference
scope: QAI Lab pipeline execution and notebook-based experiment

integration_pattern.model: registry -> resolver -> binding -> connector -> adapter -> implementation -> execution -> result -> evidence

notes: Notebook remains a pilot execution reference.
The notebook is retained as an existing implementation artifact.
Do not duplicate notebook source into the General Factory unless required for execution or integration.
Factory should invoke the existing implementation through a defined interface and implementation binding.
Notebook execution should produce traceable experiment results and evidence.
The reference implementation does not define the General Framework architecture.
